profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

The company's two tracked products are Perplexity AI, a search-augmented large language model available at its main website, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise-oriented offering that the site describes as covering internal knowledge search, data indexing, single sign-on, and audit logs. Perplexity also maintains a presence in the MCP server registry through two listed servers, one described as enabling real-time web search, reasoning, and research through its API, and another described as enabling AI assistants to perform web searches using its Sonar Pro model.

Perplexity is named as a defendant or respondent in nine tracked legal proceedings. Publishers and media organizations bringing cases against it in the Southern District of New York include The New York Times Company, Cable News Network Inc., Chicago Tribune Company LLC, and Encyclopaedia Britannica Inc. Amazon.com Services LLC has filed suit in the Northern District of California and has a related matter before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Additional cases brought by parties named Gagleard appear in both the Eastern and Northern Districts of California, and a case brought by Noel is also on file in the Northern District of California.
